component.name: AeroClean
component.summary: Free up disk space, with a glossy 2000s look

description.p: AeroClean finds what's taking up space and cleans it safely, in a bright Frutiger Aero style with glass panels, bubbles and soft animations.

ul.li: Clean caches, thumbnails, the trash, old logs, package caches and unused Flatpak runtimes
Find big files, duplicates and similar photos, and see your disk as a map
Developer caches: Cargo, npm, pnpm, Yarn, Go, Maven, Gradle and old build folders
Leftovers of apps you've removed, startup apps and boot time
Undo a clean for 24 hours, and a weekly automatic clean
Themes: a live Theme Studio, day and night themes, themes from a picture and a community gallery

description.p: Everything is shown before it's removed, and nothing that needs a password is cleaned without asking. Available in English, French, Spanish, German and Portuguese.

screenshot.caption: The cleaner, with everything shown before it's removed

description.p: Settings in one readable file, a Flatpak version, themes that switch by day and night, themes from a picture, seasonal touches and sounds.
